notes.title: ToW2 - New gameplay reveal & release date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are happy to announce a Helltaker-like game from our partner Galart - Tower of Waifus 2 will be released on June 18, 2021.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1560770/Tower_of_Waifus_2/
And here is the gameplay reveal of the game:
[previewyoutube=HkwL_4S0gTs;full][/previewyoutube]
Wish list now to grab it on launch sale!

notes.title: Update 2.0.0 - new story, new character!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We just updated the game to version 2.0.0 that added new story and character, here is the detail change log:
- Add Lily, unlock when the player finishes the boss and choose Enter the portal
- Added effect when activating skill
- improve Odine's story backgrounds
- Add dialog skip button
- Improve Character animation loading performance
- Fixed Girl load overlapping bug

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 fixed stuck when starting with Odine
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We just update Love Fantasy to 1.0.1 and here is the change log:
- Fixed bugs sometimes stuck when starting with Odine
- Increased gold received
- Fixed missing Chinese text and Chinese typo
- Fixed Hikaru's clothes not torn when fighting
- Improved anim Iwe
- Fixed an issue that caused conversations to shut down too quickly
